description: Ordered task sequences for continuous workflow simulation. Sequences reset before the session, disclose prompts and inject regressions one task at a time, preserve source/tool/agent state between tasks, and re-root model-facing Git metadata to prevent answer leakage.

persist_between_tasks: repository source working tree; controller re-roots model-facing Git metadata before each task
memory/state stores enabled by the active profile

readiness_blockers: Supplemental mutations are under-specified exact-source restoration checks rather than causally related behavioral acceptance.
sequences.reset_policy: Reset once before the session; preserve source, tool, index, cache, generated config, memory, and agent state between tasks; inject only the current regression and re-root model-facing Git metadata before disclosure.
sequences.conversion_note: Shared-snapshot candidate: five OrchardCore regressions target commit 91cd8a4bfcaf9cb1388edef6867af2a0b5a0a000, but the synthetic supplemental guards require behavioral redesign before activation.
sequences.seed_patch_policy: Candidate-only: patches must be injected one task at a time, and supplemental exact-source mutations must be replaced with causally related behavior plus behavioral tests before activation.
sequences.complexity_note: The 2026-07-08 five-file expansion mixed core behavior with unrelated exact-source sentinels; it is retained for audit only and is not a valid active task design.
sequences.complexity_bar: Five production files were touched and mechanical seeded-fail/fixed-pass gates passed, but behavioral validity failed; redesign is required.

sequences.complexity_note: Each task is reconstructed from a real upstream Fastify behavior or performance change and changes only its causally related production/type files.
